# netbox_export_template (Resource)

From the [official documentation](https://docs.netbox.dev/en/stable/models/customization/exporttemplate/):

> An export template renders a list of objects into a custom format with Jinja2.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "netbox_export_template" "example" {
  name = "example"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) The name of the export template.
- `object_types` (Set of String) The object types the export template applies to.
- `template_code` (String) Jinja template code. With `data_file_id` NetBox keeps it equal to the content of the data file, so write the same content.

### Optional

- `as_attachment` (Boolean) Download file as attachment. Defaults to `false`.
- `auto_sync_enabled` (Boolean) Enable automatic synchronization of data when the data file is updated. Needs `data_file_id`. Defaults to `false`. Needs NetBox 4.7.0 or later.
- `data_file_id` (Number) The ID of the data file the export template takes its content from. NetBox sets `data_source_id` and `data_path` from it and keeps the content in sync with the file, so write the same content as the file has. Data files are created when a data source is synced in NetBox, and the data source `netbox_data_file` finds one. NetBox 4.7.0 and older do not allow removing a data file from an object, so replace the object instead.
- `data_source_id` (Number, Deprecated) The ID of the data source of the data file. NetBox sets it from `data_file_id`, so do not set it. It is 0 while there is no data file.
- `description` (String) A description of the export template.
- `environment_params` (String) Any <a href="https://jinja.palletsprojects.com/en/stable/api/#jinja2.Environment">additional parameters</a> to pass when constructing the Jinja environment.
- `file_extension` (String) Extension to append to the rendered filename.
- `file_name` (String) Filename to give to the rendered export file.
- `mime_type` (String) Defaults to <code>text/plain; charset=utf-8</code>.
- `owner_id` (Number) The ID of the owner associated with the export template. Needs NetBox 4.5.0 or later.

### Read-Only

- `created` (String) When the export template was created.
- `data_path` (String) The data path of the export template.
- `data_synced` (String) The data synced of the export template.
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `last_updated` (String) When the export template was last changed.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# The ID is the numeric NetBox ID of the object
terraform import netbox_export_template.example 1
```
